fusions.name: Snatch and Shove
fusions.desc: You rush up to the target, then a quick grab deals 16 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ruckus
fusions.desc: Cuffs every enemy within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 8 damage and having a 50% chance to confuse the target for 3 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Decoy Roar
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. An escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocketed Gains
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
